text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mejiro Bright having not shown up for training, I head off to look for her. Then, while searching…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wooow… That cloud looks just like a little bird…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Are you flying over to that big, puffy cloud, little bird?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You can make it! It's perfectly fine to drift slowly but surely. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, greetings, Trainer. I've been gazing at the clouds up in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why, it's as if a story is unfolding before my very eyes. I could watch them all day.
choice_data_list: Would that leave time for training?
Would that leave time for training?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I apologize, sincerely… I only meant to gaze at the clouds for a few moments…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I have brought shame to the Mejiro name. You have my word that this will not happen again…
